invariants.observableFact: Default and Pixel use the same Collection modal shell with collection banner, variant name, produce preview, difficulty row, status region, and action arranged in that top-to-bottom order.
The preview visibly contains ten representative fruit layers.
The fruit layers overlap into one dense produce mass rather than appearing as separated icons.
Inspection of the preview bindings resolves every fruit layer to an actual product sprite asset rather than a placeholder or reconstructed substitute.
Exactly one previous control and one next control are visible beside the preview.
Both navigation controls remain fully visible outside the clipped preview content.
No back control appears in either the modal body or the collection title banner.
Interaction inspection finds no BackAction assigned to the modal body or collection title banner.

variants.observableFact: The Default variant name is visibly rendered as "DEFAULT FRUIT".
The Default difficulty meter visibly communicates level 1 with one accent star followed by two muted stars.
The Default preview places larger melon forms across the rear and upper area while smaller fruit overlap across the foreground and lower edge.
The Pixel variant name is visibly rendered as "PIXEL FRUIT".
The Pixel difficulty meter visibly communicates level 2 with two accent stars followed by one muted star.

states.observableFact: The active-state action visibly reads "IN USE".
The active-state action has a visually settled active treatment, using a filled green rounded control with a dark outline and white uppercase label.
The active-state action reports non-interactable and does not invoke a set-selection action when activated.
The unlocked selectable-state action visibly reads "USE THIS SET".
The unlocked selectable-state action has a visible selectable treatment distinguishable from the active treatment.
The unlocked selectable-state action reports interactable and accepts activation.

wholeFrameChecks.observableFact: A muted, softly defocused gray backdrop surrounds the modal without competing with its foreground hierarchy.
A tall off-white rounded card is centered in the portrait frame with a dark hand-drawn outline, cast shadow, and clear surrounding space.
The landscape produce preview is the largest interior visual region and occupies the middle of the card hierarchy.
Small green leaf accents decorate the card at the upper-left and lower-right corners.
On the Xiaomi 23043RP34G, the complete card, decorative accents, navigation controls, labels, preview, and action remain visible without frame-edge clipping.
On the Xiaomi 23043RP34G, text, artwork, navigation controls, status, and action do not overlap or occlude one another.
The active review runtime reports device model Xiaomi 23043RP34G, package com.joewrks.mergedrop.visual, and version 0.1.3 (4).

focusedChecks.observableFact: The top banner is a green illustrated ribbon with a dark outline and centered white uppercase "COLLECTION" text.
Primary labels use bold uppercase display lettering, with dark lettering on the cream card and white lettering on green controls.
The preview is clipped cleanly to a landscape rounded rectangle with a strong dark border.
The Default fruit mass fills the preview edge-to-edge, with intentional cropping at the preview boundary and no large empty interior gaps.
Each fruit remains recognizably proportioned with no visible stretching or squashing.
Fruit artwork retains its intended opacity without unintended global fading or translucency.
The previous and next controls are compact orange-gold, dark-outlined arrow icons that flank the preview at matching vertical positions.
A centered "DIFFICULTY" label and horizontal three-star meter appear directly below the preview.
The state action is a wide rounded horizontal control inset near the bottom of the card.
The Default active presentation shows a centered "UNLOCKED" status between the difficulty row and the action.
Activating previous navigates to the preceding collection variant, while activating next navigates to the following collection variant.
